subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

She cracked the most funniest joke at the party.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "the most funniest" is** incorrect **because "funniest" is already in the superlative form.
 
• Using both "most" and "funniest" together is** redundant.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "the funniest".

Hence, the correct statement is **'*She cracked the funniest__ joke at the party*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When using adjectives in the superlative form **(e.g., funniest, tallest, smallest), do not use** **"most"** before them.
 
• **Superlative adjectives inherently indicate the highest degree of comparison,** so adding** "most"** is** unnecessary and grammatically incorrect.**
